title: Sketch polynomial
summary:
The users can sketch a curve (red line). The resulting point cloud is converted by the Visvalingam algorithm to a list consisting of a start point and an end point, as well as internal points. The overall number of these points is given as the slider value . Then, these points are interpolated by a Lagrange polynomial of degree .
